en.text: 27.The equation of the circle \(C\) is \(5x^2+5y^2-30x+10y+6=0\). Which of the following is true?

questions.stem:
27.Denote the circle \(x^2+y^2+4x-12y+15=0\) by \(C\). Which of the following is/are true?
I.The area of \(C\) is \(25\pi\).II.The point \((-3,3)\) lies outside \(C\).III.The centre of \(C\) lies in the fourth quadrant.
questions.solution: Answer A (I only). Completing the square gives \((x+2)^2+(y-6)^2=25\): centre \((-2,6)\), radius 5, area \(25\pi\). The point \((-3,3)\) has squared distance \(1+9=10<25\) from the centre and is inside. The centre is in quadrant II. Thus II and III are false. The supplied note’s answer B was corrected by independent calculation.
questions.solutionZh: 答案 A（只有 I）。配方得 \((x+2)^2+(y-6)^2=25\)，圓心為 \((-2,6)\)，半徑為 5，面積為 \(25\pi\)。點 \((-3,3)\) 到圓心的距離平方為 \(1+9=10<25\)，所以在圓內；圓心位於第二象限。因此 II、III 均不正確。來源筆記的答案 B 已按獨立計算更正。
